content:
Priya (Support): Heads up — customer acct_0x9f3 reporting API 403s and negative balance after a chargeback. They say promo trial credits vanished at the same time. Repro steps below.
Eli (Billing): Can you share the account id, invoice id, and chargeback id so I can look it up in the ledger?
Priya (Support): Account: acct_0x9f3. Invoice: inv_2026_9981. Chargeback: cb_2026_4812. Request ID from customer logs: req_3b2a. Promo code applied was NEWYEAR50 (50 credits). Customer says card dispute triggered reversal and then their compute stopped due to negative balance.
BillingBot: Automated notice — chargeback cb_2026_4812 processed for $75. Promo credit reversal applied per policy v2.1.
Sam (Eng): Quick question: did the system remove only the promo-credited tokens or both promo + purchased credits? We need the exact delta.
Priya (Support): It removed 50 promo credits and also pulled standard credits down to put balance at -24.50. Customer was on trial so majority was promo. They got throttled mid-request and saw streaming cut off.
Sam (Eng): Can you paste the reconcile job logs — suspect reconcile_promos job might be applying reversal twice in edge case.
Priya (Support): Log snippet:
```
2026-12-05T02:11:58Z reconcile_promos:start job_id=jr_71
2026-12-05T02:12:01Z reconcile_promos:error promo_revocation: duplicate_key_update account=acct_0x9f3
2026-12-05T02:12:02Z reconcile_promos:retry job_id=jr_71
2026-12-05T02:12:03Z reconcile_promos:success applied_revocations=2 account=acct_0x9f3
```
Sam (Eng): :eyes: That 'applied_revocations=2' is suspicious. It looks like a race where the job retried and didn't detect idempotency. Could produce double-clawback.
eng-oncall: For mitigation we should: 1) temporarily re-grant the 50 promo credits manually, 2) add an override to not throttle acct_0x9f3 while billing team reviews, 3) add an audit note referencing cb_2026_4812 and ticket BILL-789.
Maya (Support Lead): Agreed. Priya, please do the manual grant and document the reason in the ticket. Also check whether a partial refund should be issued.
Eli (Billing): I'll prepare the ledger correction script. Before making changes — confirm no active fraud flags. KYC shows 'identity_pending' so I'll DM security for a quick check.
Priya (Support): Granting 50 promo credits now and setting temporary billing override. DMing Eli and security for sign-off. I'll update the customer: "We found a billing system reversal that looked like a duplicate; we re-applied your trial credits while we investigate. You should be unthrottled within a minute." :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): For repro: 1) create invoice with promo applied; 2) mark invoice as charged then simulate chargeback; 3) run reconcile_promos concurrently or trigger retry path. Expect duplicate revocation if job retries without idempotency keys.
Sam (Eng): I'll open ENG-1042 to make reconcile_promos idempotent (use promo_revocation_id). ETA: small patch + test in 72h, hotfix if we see more incidents.
Maya (Support Lead): Please ensure BILL-789 links to ENG-1042 and include customer communication draft. Priya, escalate to account team if customer asks for refund; billing will advise on reimbursements once we confirm ledger change. :eyes:
Eli (Billing): Manual ledger update queued. I'll attach a signed audit entry and refund recommendation to BILL-789 once security gives OK.
Priya (Support): Customer updated and happy for now. I'll follow up when BILL-789 is updated. Closing internal loop after ledger confirm. Thanks all.
